markdownPreview.title: Markdown Preview
markdownPreview.sample:
# Markdown Component Full Preview

Welcome to the void Markdown component preview page!

## Basic Syntax

### Text Styles

This is **bold text**, this is *italic text*, and this is ~~strikethrough~~.

You can also combine styles, like ***bold italic***.

### Lists

#### Unordered list

- Item 1
- Item 2
  - Subitem 2.1
  - Subitem 2.2
- Item 3

#### Ordered list

1. Step one
2. Step two
3. Step three

#### Task list

- [x] Completed task
- [ ] Pending task
- [ ] Another task

## Code Examples

### Inline code

Run `npm install` to install dependencies, then run `npm run dev` to start the dev server.

### Code blocks

```typescript
interface User {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
}

function greetUser(user: User): string {
  return `Hello, ${user.name}!`;
}

const user: User = {
  id: '1',
  name: 'Alice',
  email: 'alice@example.com'
};

console.log(greetUser(user));
```

```javascript
// JavaScript example
const fetchData = async () => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('https://api.example.com/data');
    const data = await response.json();
    return data;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error:', error);
  }
};
```

```python
# Python example
def fibonacci(n):
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    return fibonacci(n-1) + fibonacci(n-2)

for i in range(10):
    print(f"F({i}) = {fibonacci(i)}")
```

## Tables

| Feature | Description | Supported |
|------|------|---------|
| Headings | H1-H6 headings | Yes |
| Lists | Ordered/unordered lists | Yes |
| Code blocks | Syntax highlighting | Yes |
| Tables | Markdown tables | Yes |
| Links | Hyperlinks | Yes |
| Images | Image rendering | Yes |
| Blockquotes | Blockquotes | Yes |

## Blockquotes

> This is a blockquote.
> 
> It can be used to emphasize important information or quote someone.
> 
> — void Team

> **Note:** Blockquotes can include other Markdown elements, including **bold**, *italic*, and `code`.

## Links

Visit the [void website](https://void.dev) for more information.

See the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/void) for the source code.

Auto link: https://example.com

## Images

![Sample image](https://via.placeholder.com/600x300/667eea/ffffff?text=void+Markdown)

## Horizontal Rule

---

## Nested Content

### Code inside lists

1. First install dependencies:
   ```bash
   npm install react-markdown
   ```

2. Then use it in code:
   ```jsx
   import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
   
   <ReactMarkdown>{content}</ReactMarkdown>
   ```

### List inside blockquote

> #### Notes
> 
> - Make sure to properly escape special characters
> - Use appropriate syntax highlighting
> - Keep the document structure clear

## Special Formats

<details>
<summary>Click to expand details</summary>

This content is collapsed; click the title to expand.

- Supports HTML tags
- Can include Markdown content

</details>

## Summary

The void Markdown component supports:

1. Full Markdown syntax
2. GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM)
3. A polished dark theme
4. Code syntax highlighting
5. Responsive tables
6. Custom style variants

**Get started now!**

directive.inpaint: Change only the area covered by the semi-transparent red marking in this image. Every other pixel must stay exactly as in the original. Do not reproduce the red marking itself in the result.
directive.erase: Remove what sits under the semi-transparent red marking in this image and fill that area naturally with content that matches its surroundings. Every other pixel must stay exactly as in the original. Do not reproduce the red marking itself in the result.

prefill.inpaint: Turn the marked area into 【what should be there instead】.
prefill.erase: Remove 【what should go】 from the marked area.
